segments.purpose: Start on Allen?s spoken hook; establish the football moment, not a logo bumper.
segments.visual: Hook card plate with the reviewed opening claim (5-8 words), punched in at frame 0; host close/medium shot with a single lime tactical marker.
segments.audio: Voice starts at frame 0; no intro silence.

segments.purpose: Give competition, teams/player, match moment and the question being answered.
segments.visual: Fixed match-context strip; optional user-approved media from Asset Library.

segments.purpose: Explain one key tactical action or decision in Allen?s own words.
segments.visual: Host plus authored pitch-board overlay; one reusable asset slot if it improves comprehension.

segments.purpose: Show the strongest observable evidence or a fair counter-reading.
segments.visual: One source-backed stat, frame, or simple diagram; show source/date where applicable.

segments.purpose: Land one clear conclusion and one natural question for the audience.
segments.visual: Return to host; retain channel wordmark in a quiet corner.

segments.purpose: Brief fixed channel sign-off; never a separate long CTA bumper.
segments.visual: Fixed Allen Knows Ball mark and tagline, under 1.2 seconds.

transitions.use: Default between spoken argument beats; preserve conversational pace.
Reveal a tactical board or move between two pieces of match evidence; max two per video.

effects.use: Freeze a supplied, rights-cleared frame and draw one or two tactical runs; label as analysis, not broadcast graphics.
Briefly emphasize one sourced statistic; no floating clusters of metrics.
Subtle pitch geometry as a background texture, never a club crest or competition identity.

opening: Spoken hook immediately over the hook card plate; the fixed logo mark may animate in parallel for no more than 0.45 seconds.
ending: Allen?s takeaway/question leads into the fixed mark. No ?like and subscribe? script is forced.
